checks.evidence: Disabling multiple authenticators after threshold exceeded, step 6 (both factors failing to threshold disables both) plus Verification that disabled authenticators require re-binding, step 1 (valid password and TOTP rejected because authenticators are disabled). The threshold of 5 is assumed rather than 50.

invented: Threshold assumed to be 5, with failures tracked per authenticator
Resetting the failure count via an admin tool, time-based reset or new session
Password-only and second-factor-only failure scenarios, where only the involved authenticator is disabled
System prompts for re-binding or recovery
Re-binding process for authenticators, with the account fully functional again afterwards
